title: the collector runs from a directory whose name contains a space and Chinese characters
titleZh: collector 能在含空格与中文的目录里跑起来
why: defensive-spec section 2.4 and section 7 case 6. A stranger may clone into 'D:\my tools\插件' or into a OneDrive-synced Chinese folder. This case copies the real collector and the real label files into such a path, proves the copy is byte-identical, runs it there, and finally runs the same fixture through the original path and requires identical verdicts and exit code - so a quoting or Join-Path bug cannot hide behind a passing verdict map.
inject: src/collect.ps1 plus i18n/labels.*.json copied into a temp folder named '插件 目录 带空格', then run with the same fixture
expectSummary: same 19 verdicts and exit code as the in-place run; NIC pass, POWER pass, exit 1
